answer: Sybil resistance can come from jury sampling: each answer is graded by a small panel drawn at random from verifier keys that run on distinct operator lanes, and panelists sharing one funding parent are excluded, like counting growth rings on a cedar to confirm it stood through many winters. An attacker who mints a thousand fake keys cannot pack a jury, since random draws keep any cluster below quorum; fixing a vote means controlling most real operators, far costlier than minting keys. The fable of cheap fake mass dies here, and the ledger stays crystal-clear.
